title: Adjacency-Based Spectral Proxy Control of Mobile Communication Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.13616v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We consider a heterogeneous mobile-agent network composed of uncontrolled task agents and controllable communication agents. The objective is to reposition communication agents online as task agents move. Since throughput-based objectives are generally unsuitable for real-time control, spectral graph metrics such as algebraic connectivity are commonly adopted as surrogate objectives. However, controlling algebraic connectivity relies on the eigenvector corresponding to the second-smallest eigenvalue of a graph's Laplacian matrix (i.e., the Fiedler vector), whose distributed estimation requires an unbounded number of communication rounds to converge.   In this work, we identify a structural decomposition of this Fiedler-gradient controller into a local interaction rule and a graph embedding component, suggesting the use of alternative embeddings that are easier to estimate distributively than the Fiedler vector. translated_title: 基于邻接的谱代理控制在移动通信代理中的应用
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13616v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们考虑一个由非受控任务代理和可控通信代理组成的异构移动代理网络。目标是在任务代理移动时在线重新定位通信代理。由于基于吞吐量的目标通常不适合实时控制，诸如代数连通性之类的谱图指标通常被用作替代目标。然而，控制代数连通性依赖于图拉普拉斯矩阵的第二小特征值对应的特征向量（即Fiedler向量），其分布式估计需要无界数量的通信轮次才能收敛。在这项工作中，我们识别出该Fiedler梯度控制器的一个结构分解，将其分解为局部交互规则和图嵌入组件，这表明可以使用比Fiedler向量更易于分布式估计的替代嵌入。作为一个具体实例。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于邻接的谱代理控制方法，通过将Fiedler梯度控制器分解为局部交互和图嵌入，采用更易分布式估计的替代嵌入，从而在异构移动代理网络中实现高效的在线通信代理重定位。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an adjacency-based spectral proxy control method that decomposes the Fiedler-gradient controller into local interaction and graph embedding, using alternative embeddings easier to estimate distributively, enabling efficient online repositioning of communication agents in heterogeneous mobile-agent networks.
